si_table_s2_verification.source: Cui et al. Science 390, eadw8310 (2025), Supplementary Materials
si_table_s2_verification.method_description: Population distributions determined by either three-state CPMG fitting (Table S2) or population-weighted resonance analysis (Fig S5, Met305 probe)
si_table_s2_verification.tier_3_caveat: Fig S5 values are Met305 probe-specific population-weighted resonance analysis, read from histogram bars. Uncertainty estimated +/-5-10%. L410A shows probe-specificity: Table S2 global fit = 96/3/1 vs Fig S5 Met305 = 73/27/0.

tier_definitions.Tier_1: Table S2 precise values from global 3-state CPMG fit (with std errors)
tier_definitions.Tier_2: BMRB-verifiable (NOT AVAILABLE - BMRB 31233 has chemical shifts only, no populations)
tier_definitions.Tier_3: Fig S5 Met305 probe histogram readings (estimated +/-5-10% uncertainty)

traceability.caveat: Fig S5 values are Met305 PROBE-SPECIFIC populations, may differ from Table S2 global CPMG fit. L410A discrepancy: Table S2=96/3/1 vs Fig S5 Met305=73/27/0 confirms probe-specificity. SI PDF could not be directly fetched (security verification), cross-check performed via web search snippets of Table S2 header text.
traceability.abl1_comparison: Abl1 data (Xie 2020) was verified against PDF original text. Src Tier 3 data carries higher uncertainty than Abl1 gold data. Both systems use different NMR methods (Abl1: 13C CEST; Src: 13C-methyl CPMG) providing independent methodology cross-validation.

cdst_suitability.method_note: Abl1 used 13C CEST; Src used 13C-methyl CPMG. Different NMR methods = independent methodology cross-validation.
cdst_suitability.advantage: K=3 matches Abl1; different NMR methods strengthen independence claim
